svg.text: Integrated deployment across Next.js, API Gateway, and Lambda. Added early
stopping and resume for patent and literature searches, with persisted
The platform searches patent databases and academic literature for prior art.
I connected the frontend to handlers for agent invocation, S3 uploads, and
DynamoDB-backed data. For searches that outlast a page visit, I updated
polling and state persistence so users can resume an ongoing search, see the
final result count, and understand when a search stopped early.
